Name: Fruit Tree Accumulation
Author: Sable17
Description:
[size=5][quote][size=4]But Mooooom, I don't want to have to remember to shake the fruit trees every 3 days. :([/size][/quote][/size][list]
[*]Simply lets fruit trees (or anything pretending to be fruit trees) stack [b]up to 28 [/b]fruit before they need to be harvested.
[*]Trees still only grow 1 fruit per day.
[*]Works for mod added trees.
[*]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38413]Perfect Fruit[/url]. (Which I adore.)
[*]Just remember to shake your trees before the season's over!
[/list]
You can change the amount of fruit that trees can accumulate in the included config.
It's set to 28 by default, but you can cap it lower if you want. Or higher, if you've got multi-season fruit trees.

[b]Requirements[/b]
• Stardew Valley 1.6+
• SMAPI

Uses Harmony and patches: TryAddFruit
(Used in screenshot: Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn, Cornucopia More Crops, Peachy Objects)
